name: xaq-extensions
description: Build and test tooling for the code extensions. Nothing here ships: each extension's dist is one self-contained file.

scripts.build: npm run build:whoop && npm run build:google-workspace
scripts.check:dist: npm run check:dist:whoop && npm run check:dist:google-workspace
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:whoop && npm run typecheck:google-workspace
scripts.test: npm run test:whoop && npm run test:google-workspace
